feat.name: Fake Brawler
entries: You have mastered the art of the stage fight. Your unarmed strikes look devastating and deal no damage whatsoever, which is exactly what you intend.

feat.name: Fake Vigilance
entries: You appear intensely alert at all times. You gain no bonus to initiative, but everyone assumes you do, and that is its own kind of power.

feat.name: Fake Mark
entries: A mysterious sigil has appeared on your arm. It means nothing, but it came with benefits:

items: You can make the mark glow faintly on command.
Once per long rest, you may dramatically reveal the mark to gain advantage on one Charisma (Performance) check.

entries: You also develop a random quirk from the Fake Mark Quirks table.

entries.caption: Fake Mark Quirks
rows: The mark hums off-key show tunes only you can hear.
The mark itches whenever someone tells the truth nearby.
The mark rearranges itself when nobody is looking.
The mark insists, via faint glowing, that it is a birthmark.
